lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: That should be everyone.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: I'll be making raid announcements in here, so keep your eyes peeled.
"Let's Photosynthesize"? What's with the group name?

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: Last time when Exia and Trony created a group chat,

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: our attempts at photosynthesis didn't go so well.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: So I thought using this name for the group chat would give us

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: some extra motivation to give it another try.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: Is that why?

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: Then count me out.

lines.speaker: trony
lines.text: Me too.

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: Yeah, I'm not into it either.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: Oh come on, guys! Don't you think you're overreacting just a tad?

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: Elegg, is there a window near you?

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: Yeah, why?

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: Is there sunlight coming in?

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: ... Yeah.

lines.speaker: exia
lines.text: There you go. That's enough for your precious photosynthesis.

lines.speaker: trony
lines.text: Yeah, what she said!

lines.speaker: maiden
lines.text: I knew there's a reason you're the leader, Exia!

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: Mr. Commander,

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: what do you have to say about all this?
... I wish you the best, Elegg.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: What?!
